name: Premier League
notes: Baselines are Premier League long-run averages. phiTotal is the marginal over-dispersion (Var = mu + phi*mu^2); phiShared is the portion driven by the shared game state, which is what creates correlation between the two teams and prices the 'both teams' markets.
cardsPhiShared is deliberately high relative to cardsPhiTotal: referee strictness is a single factor applied to both sides, so bookings co-move far more strongly between teams than corners do.
